messages.subject: Welcome to Navrivon Platform v3
messages.body: We're thrilled to introduce our most powerful platform release yet. With AI-driven insights, real-time collaboration, and 10x performance improvements, you're now equipped to tackle enterprise challenges at scale. Our team has worked tirelessly to bring you features that not only meet your needs today but anticipate your tomorrow. Welcome aboard!

faqs.question: Is there a free trial? Do I need a credit card?
faqs.answer: Yes! All plans include a 14-day free trial with full feature access. No credit card required to get started. When your trial ends, you choose to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime.

faqs.question: How does the monthly vs. yearly pricing work?
faqs.answer: Choose your billing cycle at checkout. Yearly plans include 20% savings compared to monthly billing. Your renewal date is one year from the purchase date. You can switch between plans anytime with prorated billing.

faqs.question: What's included in API access limits?
faqs.answer: API calls include all read and write operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Starter includes 5K calls/month, Professional includes 500K/month. Enterprise plans have unlimited API calls. Rate limits are applied to prevent abuse but don't affect normal usage patterns.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Upgrade anytime to access more features. Downgrading is also allowed—if you have data that exceeds the lower plan's limits, we'll notify you and help you manage the transition smoothly.

faqs.question: Do you offer SSO and custom integrations?
faqs.answer: SSO (SAML/OAuth) is available on Professional and Enterprise plans. Custom integrations are available for Enterprise customers. Talk to our sales team to discuss your specific security and integration requirements.
